title: Settings
adminInstantPublish: You can publish instantly with no approval.
soundDescription: Play sound effects for button clicks, tab changes, purchases, and more.
styleDescription: Pick a visual style for Pixel Place.
languageDescription: Choose your display language. Preference is saved on this device and to your account when signed in.
pyxDescription: Check the status of Pyx AI services (moderator, code, analyze, check).
privacyCardDescription: Download your account data or delete your account (PostgreSQL accounts).
deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your profile and gameplay data linked to this account. This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirmPhrase: Type DELETE MY ACCOUNT to confirm
deletePasswordHint: Account password (required if you signed up with email/password)
deleteNeedLogin: Sign in with a PostgreSQL-linked account to use export or delete.
deleteSuccess: Account deleted. You have been signed out.
trustDescription: Differentiate Pixel Place from open UGC platforms: curated surfacing, optional educational catalog, and parent-managed accounts.
trustSafeMode: Safe Mode — curated games, no open Studio creation
trustEducational: Educational mode — calmer built-in game list (puzzles, exploration, strategy)
trustParentManaged: A linked parent manages Safe Mode and Educational settings. Ask them to use Parent controls.
verifiedCreatorBadge: You are a {{label}} — thank you for publishing thoughtfully.
familyPairDescription: Generate a code and give it to a parent/guardian. They link your account from the Parent tab.
